name: Employee Leave Management Approval Workflow

data.label: Employee Submits Leave Request
data.description: Employee initiates leave request with dates, type, and reason

data.label: Validate Leave Request
data.description: System validates leave balance and request parameters

data.label: Leave Balance Check
data.description: Check if employee has sufficient leave balance

data.label: Insufficient Balance Notification
data.template: Your leave request cannot be processed due to insufficient leave balance

data.label: Request Denied - Insufficient Balance
data.description: Request ends due to insufficient leave balance

data.label: Manager Notification
data.template: New leave request pending your approval from ${processData.employeeName}
data.description: Notify manager of pending leave request for approval

data.label: Manager Review & Decision
data.instructions: Review leave request details and approve or reject with comments

data.label: Manager Approval Decision
data.description: Route based on manager's approval or rejection

data.label: HR Final Notification
data.template: Leave request approved for ${processData.employeeName} from ${processData.startDate} to ${processData.endDate}
data.description: Notify HR of approved leave request

data.label: Update Leave Balance & Calendar
data.description: Update system records with approved leave

data.label: Employee Approval Notification
data.template: Your leave request has been approved by your manager
data.description: Notify employee of approved leave request

data.label: Leave Request Approved
data.description: Leave request successfully approved and processed

data.label: Rejection Notification
data.template: Your leave request has been rejected. Reason: ${processData.rejectionReason}
data.description: Notify employee of rejected leave request

data.label: Employee Re-submission Decision
data.description: Check if employee wants to modify and resubmit request

data.label: Leave Request Rejected
data.description: Leave request rejected and not resubmitted

dataModels.name: Employee
dataModels.description: Store employee profile information and manager assignments

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the employee

fields.name: firstName
fields.description: Employee's first name

fields.name: lastName
fields.description: Employee's last name

fields.name: email
fields.description: Employee's work email address

fields.name: managerId
fields.description: Reference to the employee's direct manager for approval workflows

fields.name: role
fields.description: Employee's job role or designation

fields.name: isHRAdmin
fields.description: Indicates if employee has HR administrator privileges

fields.name: hireDate
fields.description: Date when the employee was hired

constraints.email: Must be a valid email format
constraints.managerId: Must reference an existing employee ID or be null for top-level employees

dataModels.name: LeavePolicy
dataModels.description: Defines leave types, entitlements, and organizational leave rules for employees

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the leave policy

fields.name: leaveType
fields.description: Type of leave (annual, sick, personal, maternity, paternity, etc.)

fields.name: entitlementDays
fields.description: Number of days entitled per year or period

fields.name: accrualRate
fields.description: Rate at which leave accrues (days per month)

fields.name: carryOverAllowed
fields.description: Whether unused leave can be carried over to next period

fields.name: maxCarryOverDays
fields.description: Maximum number of days that can be carried over

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether this leave policy is currently active

constraints.entitlementDays: Must be greater than or equal to 0
constraints.accrualRate: Must be greater than 0 if specified

dataModels.name: LeaveBalance
dataModels.description: Track current leave balances for each employee by leave type

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the leave balance record

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee who owns this leave balance

fields.name: leavePolicyId
fields.description: Reference to the leave policy type (vacation, sick, personal, etc.)

fields.name: availableBalance
fields.description: Current available leave balance in days or hours

fields.name: usedBalance
fields.description: Total leave already used in the current period

fields.name: pendingBalance
fields.description: Leave amount currently pending approval

fields.name: lastUpdated
fields.description: Timestamp of the last balance update

relationships.description: Each leave balance belongs to one employee
Each leave balance is associated with one leave policy type

constraints.uniqueEmployeePolicy: An employee can have only one balance record per leave policy type
constraints.nonNegativeBalances: availableBalance, usedBalance, and pendingBalance must be non-negative values

dataModels.name: LeaveRequest
dataModels.description: Store leave request details, status, and approval history

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the leave request

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee submitting the request

fields.name: leaveType
fields.description: Type of leave (vacation, sick, personal, etc.)

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: Start date of the leave period

fields.name: endDate
fields.description: End date of the leave period

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Employee's reason for requesting leave

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status (pending, approved, rejected, cancelled)

fields.name: approvalHistory
fields.description: Array of approval records with approver, action, timestamp, and comments

constraints.dateValidation: endDate must be greater than or equal to startDate

forms.name: LeavePolicyForm
forms.title: Leave Policy Configuration
forms.description: Configure leave types, entitlements, and accrual rules for organizational leave policies

validation.message: Policy name must be between 3 and 50 characters
Entitlement must be between 0 and 365 days
Maximum carryover must be between 0 and 100 days
Effective date must be a valid date

fields.name: policyNotes
fields.label: Policy Notes & Conditions
fields.placeholder: Enter any additional policy details, eligibility criteria, or special conditions...

forms.name: LeaveApprovalForm
forms.title: Leave Request Approval
forms.description: Review and approve or reject employee leave requests with team availability context

fields.name: teamImpact
fields.label: Team Availability Impact
fields.placeholder: 3 team members on leave during this period. Coverage: 70% capacity available.

validation.message: Team impact details help with decision making

fields.name: managerComments
fields.label: Manager Comments
fields.placeholder: Provide mandatory comments explaining your decision...

validation.message: Comments are mandatory and must be at least 10 characters

forms.name: LeaveRequestForm
forms.title: Submit Leave Request
forms.description: Request time off by providing your leave details. Your available balance will be validated automatically.

validation.message: Start date is required and must be in the future
End date must be after or equal to start date

fields.name: reason
fields.label: Reason for Leave
fields.placeholder: Please provide a brief explanation for your leave request

validation.message: Reason must be between 10 and 500 characters
Emergency contact must not exceed 100 characters

routing.reasoning: This is a classic approval workflow domain with medium complexity (7-step process with branching for approval/rejection). ApprovalWorkflowExpert is ideal for leave request patterns. SQL database suits the structured, relational data (employees, managers, leave balances, policies). Advanced forms needed for complex validation (date ranges, balance checks, conditional fields). Cross-platform mobile access essential for employees/managers. Multiple experts combined via ensemble for comprehensive solution covering workflow logic, data architecture, and user interfaces.
